4-Pillar Insights & Hypotheses

Separate factual evidence from inferences, identify open gaps, and formulate testable hypotheses.

Methodology: Preserving Distinction Between Observation & Conclusion
Observation: Competitors frequently emphasize fast delivery.
Insight: Delivery speed may be an important purchase consideration.
Hypothesis: Prominent delivery messaging may improve conversion.

1. Facts

What the available evidence actually supports.

2. Insights

What those facts may mean for the business.

3. Research Gaps

Important unknowns we still need to investigate.

4. Hypotheses

Ideas worth testing rather than treating as facts.
